_comment: Words whose level a person has decided, and the band each must land in.
The model is a model. These are the sentences a reviewer would use to say it
is wrong: if 사람 is not in the first sixth of the scale, or 사로잡다 is not
in the last third, the ladder has slipped and no aggregate statistic will
say so. `vocabulary:level:qa` reads this file and fails on a miss.
Bands are wide on purpose. The claim being made is 'this is a beginner word',
not 'this is exactly level 4' — nobody can defend the second one, and a check
that demands it would be re-tuned into meaninglessness the first time it
fired. See docs/VOCABULARY_LEVEL_CALIBRATION.md for how the bands were set.
Every word here exists in the taught corpus. A missing anchor is an error,
because an anchor that silently stops being checked is worse than none.

foundation.why: a Korean course teaches these in its first weeks

early.why: the first few months; useful, and none of it obscure

middle.why: beyond survival Korean and short of literary; a wide band because the middle of a vocabulary genuinely is wide

advanced.why: needs real Korean to use correctly, not merely to recognise

expert.why: cannot be worked out from its parts at all
